Retrieves values from one column of a quitte object

Source: R/getColValues.R
getColValues.Rd

Retrieves values from one column of a quitte object

Usage

getColValues(df, colVar)

Arguments

df

quitte object

colVar

name of the column of interest

Value

a vector containing the values of the column without duplicates. The class of the returned vector is either numeric or character

Author

Antoine Levesque

Examples

data(mtcars)
getColValues(mtcars,"mpg")
#>  [1] 21.0 22.8 21.4 18.7 18.1 14.3 24.4 19.2 17.8 16.4 17.3 15.2 10.4
#> [14] 14.7 32.4 30.4 33.9 21.5 15.5 13.3 27.3 26.0 15.8 19.7 15.0
